definitions.explanation: A machine that converts mechanical energy into electricity, from small portable units for camping and emergencies to large machines in power plants.

examples.japanese: {発電機|はつでんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧{発電機|はつでんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: Prepare a generator in case of a power outage.

examples.english: In a disaster, an emergency generator can secure a minimum amount of electricity.

notes:
A device that generates electricity from mechanical motion, ranging from small engine-driven units to the large machines inside power stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発電機|はつでんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to run a generator
- ⟦{非常用|ひじょうよう}→非常用：28550_hijouyou⟧{発電機|はつでんき}: emergency generator
- ⟦{風力|ふうりょく}→風力：06432_fuuryoku⟧{発電機|はつでんき}: wind-power generator (wind turbine)
